Interpretation: The client searches for the previously saved network profile.
The AP advertises a WPA2/WPA3 transition configuration supporting both PSK and SAE authentication methods.
The client initiates the authentication process with the AP.
The AP accepts the client's authentication request.
The client proceeds with association despite the modified AKM configuration.
The AP accepts the association request and allows the connection process to continue.
The client proves possession of the Pairwise Master Key and participates in key derivation.
The AP distributes group key material and installs session keys.
The client confirms key installation and completes the 4-Way Handshake.
